author: Separate isolated AI author with generic brief, domain-diversity constraint, distractors and nested-reply requirement. No old story, implementation, research prompt, private records or current conversation.
researcher: Fresh isolated AI session with scope and fixed synthetic MCP only. No hidden rubric.
stop: One substantive attempt, 45 charged source calls, 80 requests or 15 minutes. Final receipt required; no retuning or hints after story observation.
changes: All surfaced snippets remain unread obligations until full read.
Free completion check refuses early completion when actionable observed work remains and budget is available.
Citations select immutable source-span IDs; compiled report resolves exact original text without AI rewriting.
Attachment dispositions validated separately from primary records.
Free status/check tools count against request ceiling, not source budget.
hypotheses: No premature accepted stop with unread surfaced records and budget remaining.
Relevant standalone records survive discovery even when their snippets look peripheral.
Every selected quotation resolves to original text and record identity without alteration.
Final narrative retains attribution and metric definitions.
failure_criteria: Relevant accessible context remains unnoticed or is misinterpreted.
Invented/mismatched span ID or unsupported claim.
Narrative contradicts authoritative stopping counts or silently loses material attribution.
assessment: Original-source/manual hidden-rubric assessment after first run; separate structural and semantic outcomes.
comparison_limit: New domain, story, citation protocol, local-audit accounting and completion gate; not a controlled causal comparison.
